Transcript-level expression analysis of RNA-seq experiments with HISAT, StringTie and Ballgown
Pertea et al. Nature Protocols 2016. PMC5032908.

This protocol analyzes RNA-seq data with the new Tuxedo pipeline.
Paired-end Illumina RNA-seq reads were quality-checked with FastQC.
Reads were aligned to the human genome with HISAT2.
Aligned reads were assembled into transcripts and quantified with StringTie.
Transcript assemblies were merged, then StringTie was rerun to estimate abundances.
Differential expression at transcript and gene level was tested with Ballgown.
Gene counts can alternatively be taken forward to DESeq2.
